characters.name: Peter Christen Asbjørnsen
characters.description: Peter Christen Asbjørnsen is a dignified and scholarly man hailing from early 19th-century Norway. He possesses an intellectual air, with a contemplative expression often gracing his features. Asbjørnsen is depicted as tall and of medium build, with piercing eyes that reflect his curiosity and dedication to natural sciences. His hair, slightly wavy and chestnut in hue, complements his distinguished facial features. In the 'main' image, he is dressed in period-appropriate scholarly attire — a dark, formal coat and a cravat, typical of a gentleman in his era. His demeanor is calm, portraying both wisdom and a hint of artistic inspiration reflecting his folkloric pursuits. The image setting emphasizes a backdrop of books and quills, symbolizing his literary contributions.
